rules.board: Göreme is a 6 × 5 ways slot: 3 to 6 matching symbols on adjacent reels from the left pay, on up to 15,625 ways. Balloon wilds substitute and carry multipliers that multiply along a way.
rules.features: After a paid board, every balloon rises a row, drifts with the wind, gains +1 and the other cells respin; two balloons in one cell merge. 3+ Dawn Suns start the Dawn Festival, where exiting balloons moor in the sky band and raise the sky multiplier.
rules.fixed: The whole round is fixed by the engine before the presentation starts; animation, speed and the sound never change it.

steps.bet: Choose your bet. The − and + buttons change the bet by one step; tap the bet amount to open every step. “Max bet” picks the highest step your balance allows.
steps.spin: Spin. Press the sun button or use the space bar. The round cost ({factor} times the bet when Chance ×2 is on) is deducted from the balance once.
steps.ways: Ways. A symbol pays when it appears on 3 or more adjacent reels starting from the left reel, in any row. Every combination of one cell per reel is a way; with five rows on six reels there are up to {ways} ways.
steps.lift: Rising balloons. After a board pays, every balloon rises one row, drifts one reel with the wind and gains +1; the other cells spin again and the new board pays in full. The chain ends when no balloon is left (at most 20 lifts).
steps.result: The result. The whole round is determined by the engine before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result. The spin button stays locked until the round (every lift, respin and free spin) has finished; use the Quick/Turbo setting to speed it up. The speed setting, tapping the celebration counter, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change the payout; the round always closes once, with the engine's payout.

how.note: DEMO credit has no value; it does not earn SOL, tokens or rewards. Göreme and Cappadocia are geography; the fairy chimneys, dovecotes, Avanos pottery and kilim motifs are drawn originally for this game.

pay.lead: Amounts are the gross DEMO pay per way at a bet of {bet}, for a run of 3, 4, 5 or 6 reels from the left. A win is the per-way pay times the number of ways (multiplied by the balloon multipliers on those ways).
pay.example: Example: {name} on all six reels pays {amount} DEMO per way; with every cell filled that would be up to {ways} ways. The round total never exceeds {max}.
pay.sunText: Suns count only on the round's first board and pay a multiple of the bet. In the Dawn Festival, 3 or more suns on a board give +5 free spins.
pay.balloonText: Substitutes for every symbol except the sun and pays nothing alone. It lands with {values}; every lift adds +1 (at most ×{max}). On one reel balloon values add up; across reels they multiply along a way.
pay.maxText: At this bet: {amount}. If the round total reaches this cap, the round ends immediately; the remaining spins are not played.

ways.title: How ways are counted
ways.text: For each pay symbol the game looks at the reels from the left. A reel continues the run if it holds that symbol or a balloon. The run must be at least 3 reels long and contain at least one real symbol.
ways.formula: Win = pay per way × (product over the run of (symbols + balloon values on the reel) − product of the balloon values alone).
ways.example: Example: the symbol twice on reel 1, once on reel 2 and once plus a ×3 balloon on reel 3 gives (2) × (1) × (1 + 3) − 0 = 8 weighted ways. The subtraction removes ways made only of balloons.

lift.title: Rising balloons and the wind
lift.text: After a board pays, a lift follows if a balloon is on the board: the wind picks a direction (left, calm or right), every balloon rises one row, drifts one reel with the wind (it stops at the edge) and its multiplier grows by 1 (at most ×{max}). A balloon that leaves the top row flies away. The other cells spin again and the board pays in full. At most {lifts} lifts per spin.

merge.title: Merges
merge.text: When two balloons arrive in the same cell they become one giant balloon whose multiplier is the sum of both (at most ×{max}). Merges are rare: they happen when the wind pushes balloons against the board edge.

free.title: Dawn Festival (free spins)
free.text: 3 / 4 / 5 / 6+ Dawn Suns on the first board award {s3} / {s4} / {s5} / {s6} free spins. In the feature balloons stay on the board between spins and every free spin with balloons is a lift. 3+ suns on a free spin give +{retrigger} spins (at most {max} in total).
free.sky: Sky band: a balloon that leaves the top row during the feature moors in the sky band above the reels. The sky multiplier (×1 until the first mooring, then the sum of all moored balloon values) multiplies every win until the feature ends and never falls.

cumulative.title: Cumulative win
cumulative.text: The win meter never resets during a round: every lift, respin and free spin adds to it. A round with free spins always ends with the total screen.

tiers.title: Win tiers
tiers.text: Round total / bet: {big} from 10×, {mega} from 25×, {super} from 50×, {epic} from 100×, and {max} for a round that reaches the cap. The counter climbs through the tiers.

ante.title: Chance ×2 · a spin costs {cost}
ante.text: The bet costs {factor} times as much and the base board holds more suns: the Dawn Festival comes about twice as often (simulation {ante} of rounds instead of {standard}). Wins are still paid on the base bet.

buy.title: Buy bonus · {price}
buy.text: Starts a round whose first board holds at least {suns} Dawn Suns, so the Dawn Festival always follows. Purchase RTP {rtp}. Not available with Chance ×2 or during autoplay.

rtp.title: Return to player (RTP)
rtp.caption: RTP per mode
rtp.text: Estimates from {millions} million round simulations per mode for standard and Chance ×2 and {buyMillions} million for the purchase, each in its own process. Base-spin hit rate {hit}. Standard deviation per round: {sdStandard} (standard), {sdBuy} (purchase).
rtp.note: The RTP is a long-run average; a session can end anywhere. This DEMO game is uncertified; the interval is a normal approximation and optimistic for this heavy tail.

limits.title: Bet and win limits
limits.text1: Wins are always paid on the base bet, in every mode.
limits.text2: A round that reaches {times}× bet ends immediately; the remaining spins are not played.

keys.heading: Keyboard
keys.spaceText: Spins (can be turned off: {option}). During a round it only continues a hold screen.
keys.enterText: Same as Space outside buttons and dialogs.
keys.escText: Closes a dialog (not the session reminder).
keys.tabText: Moves between the controls; every control is reachable.
keys.note: Screen readers announce every win, lift, merge, mooring and the round result.

fault.title: Malfunction clause
fault.p1: A malfunction voids all affected games and payouts.
fault.p2: If the presentation and the engine result disagree, the engine result (round record) is valid.
fault.p3: DEMO credit has no monetary value.
